projects.name: a11y-fixer
projects.description: Accessibility audit bot for GitHub PRs. Runs axe-core via Playwright on every pull request, detects new accessibility violations, and posts structured feedback as a PR comment.
projects.stack: TypeScript, GitHub Actions, Playwright, axe-core, Biome, Vitest
projects.goal: Evolve a11y-fixer from v0.6.0 to a reliable CI accessibility enforcement tool with clear differentiation
projects.constraints: ["No SaaS lock-in for core auditing","English only for GitHub issues/PRs","Build before every commit that changes source"]
